scope_questions.question: Which released upstream versions define expectations?
scope_questions.reason: Review commits are source-study snapshots, not release/dependency pins.
scope_questions.resolution: Each reference_version is the exact 40-character source-study commit in SOURCE_REVIEW.md. These are reproducible source identities, not release/dependency tags.

scope_questions.question: Which non-Android formats/platforms belong in scope?
scope_questions.reason: The product is APK-focused; the references span broader binary and JVM workflows.
scope_questions.resolution: For this candidate inventory, Android APK/DEX/AXML/ARSC analysis plus the currently declared native ELF workflow are in scope. M07 may translate supported Android DEX into JVM classes/JAR and offer decompiler views over that generated output; opening arbitrary pre-existing JVM/JAR inputs and non-ELF formats are deferred.

scope_questions.question: Which unreviewed feature families are release candidates?
scope_questions.reason: Selected entrypoints do not audit every plugin, protocol, rule, processor, or device module.
scope_questions.resolution: The 0.2 M00 denominator is the complete set of capabilities promised in docs/CAPABILITIES.md plus first-party 0.2 commitments. Each is named as candidate or deferred in this ledger. This is a bounded release scope, not an exhaustive catalog of all upstream functionality; unlisted upstream features are not implicit promises and require a later scoped inventory change.

scope_questions.question: Which Android OS/ABI/device or emulator qualifies runtime acceptance?
scope_questions.reason: No compatible device is configured and the current host Frida helper failed.
scope_questions.resolution: Choose a compatible owned Android device/emulator and target ABI before M02 runtime acceptance.

scope_questions.question: Which rule sources/licenses may be used, and what corpus is acceptable?
scope_questions.reason: No APKiD/MobSF/Quark ruleset is included; terms differ by source.
scope_questions.resolution: Do not import upstream APKiD/MobSF/Quark rules in this candidate. Any rules added are APK-GOD-original, versioned and fixture-tested; revisit provenance before any reuse.

scope_questions.question: Which decompiler/debugger backend and distribution model are acceptable?
scope_questions.reason: Ghidra/LLDB/Rizin are not product dependencies; redistribution terms need review.
scope_questions.resolution: Native debugger APIs, UI and license parity are excluded from the 0.2 candidate denominator pending a named embedded backend and target matrix. The related debugger rows are explicitly deferred; re-open the question for a later milestone rather than imply an integration.

scope_questions.question: Which browser workflows and Windows/Python combinations define release support?
scope_questions.reason: HTTP tests exist; real browser and clean Windows execution remain unverified.
scope_questions.resolution: Declare browser/Windows/Python support from actual M01 clean-install and browser runs.

scope_questions.question: Which source/APK identity and behavior define the Tong Radio benchmark?
scope_questions.reason: The owner benchmark is deferred until M09 readiness.
scope_questions.resolution: The owner must provide the exact Tong Radio APK/source/build identity when M09 is ready.

scope_questions.question: Which real AI model and thresholds define AI-quality acceptance?
